title: RB Demo Zone/Address
description: Zone, address, and address-group demo on nsm_rb_demo_zone_addresses: 20 zones, 504 addresses (incl. 4-level IPA hierarchy Kontinent→Land→Stadt→Host), 103 groups (incl. nested demo-ipa-grp-1/2/3), and 500 rules (rules 1–20: 1–20 addresses/groups per side; rule 21: overlapping prefixes across hierarchy levels for IP Analyzer; assigns random IPAM hosts/prefixes to demo-addr-host-* on apply). Requires nsm_schema (ANY seed object).
confirm_label: I confirm that IP addresses and prefixes may be created in IPAM.
